function.name: get_user_info
function.description: Use this tool to get comprehensive user and workflow information including: user authentication status, Cyoda environment URL and deployment status, repository details (git branch, repository name, URL, installation ID), programming language, workflow state and name, build/deployment status, user requests, file attachments, and any other workflow cache data. This provides the complete context needed to understand the user's current application development state.

user_request.description: The user's request or query for context
